newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Ecuador president's visit starts with a scare.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador president's visit starts with a scare.

text.p: A man was arrested on Tuesday with a suitcase packed with several pounds (kgs) of dynamite as he tried to enter Bogota city hall during a meeting between visiting Ecuadoran President Abdala Bucaram and mayor Antanas Mockus, Colombian police said.
The man was handed over to prosecutors and the explosives were confiscated, police said. The incident came on the first day of Bucaram's two-day official visit to Colombia.
Police said that the man, who was not identified, told them he was going to exchange the dynamite for a $100 Christmas gift voucher under a festive season weapons amnesty introduced by Mockus.

The guns-for-gifts swaps began at the start of this month and is being administered by city hall and a number of churches in the capital. Several hundred pistols, machine guns and knives and several pounds of dynamite have already been exchanged, city officials said.
